DSU Online: Degree with Added Value
Is DSU Online approved by the UGC?
Yes. All online degree programs offered by DSU Online are UGC‑Entitled, ensuring they are recognized and equivalent to regular on‑campus degrees.
Can I apply for multiple programs at DSU Online?
A student can pursue two academic programmes, in Online mode simultaneously.
Is the online BBA /B.Com / BCA / MBA / MCA degree equal to a regular degree?
Yes. DSU’s online degree courses are equivalent to traditional on‑campus degrees, as per UGC guidelines, and are recognized across industries and for higher studies.
Are the online degrees from DSU Online recognized and valid?

Yes, all degrees offered through DSU Online are recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the university is NAAC A+ accredited. These degrees are fully valid and hold the same academic weight as traditional on‑campus degrees.
Yes. DSU Online (Dayananda Sagar University) is a private university established by the Karnataka State Act and is officially recognized by the UGC. It operates under full regulatory compliance.

How many electives can students choose during the program?
Two electives can be chosen: one major and one minor
Yes. DSU is accredited with NAAC A+ grade.
Is the online MBA degree recognised and at par with a regular on-campus degree?
Yes. The online MBA degree from DSU is considered at par with an on-campus degree.
Is the online MBA degree recognised by employers?
Yes. DSU is accredited by NAAC with A+ grade and the online MBA degree is a UGC-Entitled degree; thus, the degree is recognised by employers.
How flexible is the MBA programme for working professionals?

The programme is 100% online with flexible schedules, offering evening or weekend classes, live and recorded sessions, with self-paced learning modules that are accessible 24/7 to accommodate working professionals.
Will an online MBA provide the same networking opportunities?
Yes. Students gain access to virtual networking events, discussion forums, mentorship, webinars with industry leaders for enhanced professional connections.
How will students know important dates for the programme?
The academic calendar will be published with timelines.
Are there opportunities for practical and experiential learning in the MBA programme?
Yes, the programme includes case studies, internships, projects, industry-focused assignments to enhance real-world business skills.
Is the MBA programme accredited and globally recognised?
Yes. Dayananda Sagar University is accredited by NAAC with A+ and adheres to international academic standards, making the degree globally recognised and valued.
Is the course study material available online?
Yes. The course study material of the online programme will be available through the University’s Learning Portal.
How is the online study material made available to the students?
The course study material for the online programme is designed with a four-quadrant approach and is available to students on the University’s LMS:

items: Quadrant-I, i.e., e-Tutorial, faculty-led video and audio contents
Quadrant-II, i.e., e-Content with illustrations, video demonstrations, documents as required.
Quadrant-III, i.e., discussion forums for doubt clarifications. Responses to which shall be provided by the course coordinator(s). Peer interaction is also supported.
Quadrant-IV, i.e., self-assessment, in the form of MCQs, problems, quizzes, assignments with solutions.

blocks.x: What kind of networking opportunities are available to MBA students?
Students gain access to virtual networking events, discussion forums, mentorship, webinars with industry leaders for enhanced professional connections.
How will the programme delivery be done?
The programme delivery will be fully online ensuring flexibility and accessibility for all students. Live, interactive lectures will be conducted by course coordinators on weekends.
What kind of support will online learners receive from the programme?
The four-quadrant course design approach will ensure a seamless and engaging learning experience. Dedicated course mentors will provide learning support to the students.
Will students be provided mentorship during the programme?
Yes. Guidance and mentoring from course coordinators will help students to navigate any academic challenges. Dedicated mentors to assist in learning and academic-related support.
How will evaluations be done during the programme?
A student shall be assessed for a course through Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) and Semester End Examination (SEE). CIA and SEE will have 30:70 percent weightage, respectively.
What career options are available after completing the MBA programme?

Students can explore professions in Financial Management, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management, IT & Systems Management, Supply Chain Management, Entrepreneurship, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

The curriculum of the online MBA programme has been crafted by management experts; it thoughtfully incorporates contemporary business and management topics alongside courses fostering contemporary business awareness. The curriculum and syllabus are approved by the Board of Studies as per University norms.
